item.title: December 1.0 (83)
item.description:
## What's new
- **Settings is now eight panes.** A sidebar with General, Appearance, Terminal, Markdown, Cloud Storage, Coding Agents, AI and Shortcuts — no more one long scroll. `⌘1` – `⌘8` switch between them, and the window remembers its size and the pane you were last on. - **Edit in External Editor (F4).** F4 opens the selected files in the editor chosen in Settings ▸ General. Visual Studio Code by default, any app via "Choose…". Directories are skipped, and a missing editor says so instead of opening the file in something else. - **⌘V works in Go to Folder.** An open command panel no longer counts as the file list, so a path pastes normally. Paste as Move is refused while a panel is in front, so a stray chord can no longer move files into the pane behind it.
### Under the hood
- Full Disk Access sits at the top of General, where a blocked app can find it, instead of at the bottom of the list. - The file list keeps `⌘C` / `⌘X` / `⌘V` only while its own window is key.
